test_case: Phantom Brew whitebox flows › cart coupon applies a visible discount to the order total
estimated_root_cause: Add to Cart click did not update cart state; cart badge stayed 0 on product detail page.
recommended_action: Inspect add-to-cart handler/store wiring for /menu/1 and ensure badge updates after successful add.

test_case: Phantom Brew blackbox flows › customizes a coffee item and carries the selection into the cart
estimated_root_cause: Customized item was not rendered in cart after add/customization flow; expected House Blend entry missing.
recommended_action: Verify customized item is added to cart and cart item title/options persist into cart view.

test_case: チェックアウトページ › 配送先フォームの全フィールドが表示される
estimated_root_cause: Test depends on .form-row two-column layout class; selector is brittle and element may have been refactored.
recommended_action: Assert visible form fields by stable ids/labels instead of .form-row layout container.

test_case: 注文ステータスページ › ステータスが「preparing」に進む
estimated_root_cause: Status progression is time-based/random and did not advance from received within the test's wait window.
recommended_action: Poll with longer timeout or control/mock status transitions instead of fixed timing expectation.

test_case: 注文ステータスページ › 最終的にステータスが「completed」になる
estimated_root_cause: Order status transition to completed is nondeterministic/slow; it only reached preparing before test timeout.
recommended_action: Stub status progression or increase timeout and wait on deterministic backend/event completion.

test_case: レート制限テスト › 通常のページ遷移でエラーが出ない
estimated_root_cause: Locator 'h1, .product-card' matches multiple elements, causing strict mode violation unrelated to app behavior.
recommended_action: Use a single specific locator or .first() and assert page content separately.
